title: Villainess Survival Game: Taming My Demon Butlers (DUBBED)
description: Office worker Xena Lane is obsessed with the romance game Demon Butlers and dreams of entering its world. She accidentally falls down a flight of stairs and awakens as Lily Stork, the cruel villainess who abuses her four demon butlers and is ultimately killed by them. As she faces their hatred, the system warns her: she must win their favor and reduce their Corruption Levels—or die. With one demon already near total corruption, her survival countdown begins.

title: Sniper Butterfly [Hindi]
description: When Jin Cen falls into a low point in her life, she receives a call for help from Wu Li, a rural boy she once supported. Wu Li's spirit of self-reliance moves Jin Cen, prompting her to bring Wu Li, who is about to drop out of school and has no one to rely on, to the city for education. Six years later, Wu Li, now a successful professional, returns to the city and reunites with Jin Cen due to work. While he doesn't mention the past on the surface, his feelings of love remain deep inside. Encouraged by Wu Li's sincerity and bravery, Jin Cen chooses to respond to love truthfully.

title: My Five Incredible Sisters
description: After being dumped by his accomplished girlfriend, Fabian Quinn, a modest fishmonger, stumbles upon a life-altering revelation—he has five extraordinary sisters. His eldest sister reigns as the billionaire president of Quinn Holdings, the second is a globally adored actress, the third leads the world's deadliest assassin organization, the fourth holds a formidable position as a general of Celestia, and the fifth is a renowned doctor. As his remorseful ex-girlfriend belatedly realizes the gravity of her mistake, she remains oblivious to the fact that Fabian's true identity far surpasses the remarkable achievements of his five exceptional sisters.

title: The Journey of Flower
description: It is a love story between a master and his disciple. The main character Hua Qiangu is an unlucky orphan who's looking for a chance to learn magic and martial arts to survive after her parents died. Appreciating her hard working nature and kind heart, and predicting her tragic destiny, she enters Chang Liu, an immortal sect, to seek peace and solutions. Bai Zihua, the sect leader of Chang Liu, takes her as his only disciple. Qian Gu falls in love with her teacher but doesn't reveal her true feelings until the end. Eventually, the truth has been revealed that she was born as Nü Wa's descendant and has access to godly power.She summoned the Demon God to save her master and the God transferred all his power into her body afterwards, therefore, making her the new ruler of the demons. Although Zihua tries to protect her and change her fate, Qiangu is constantly tortured by the machinations of those who wish to see her dead.

title: In Love, In Power, In Possession
description: For five years, Jared Knight relentlessly pursued Emily York, only to be dismissed as a shameless suck-up. Heartbroken, he swore never to love again—until fate led him to rescue Giselle Morgan, a woman with a hidden identity as the heiress of a powerful underworld family. Just as Jared finally lets go of Emily, she suddenly starts chasing him instead.

title: Reborn at 18: The Great-Grandma Takes Charge II
description: In 1955, Professor Rong unexpectedly passed away. Upon opening her eyes, she was transported seventy years into the body of Rong Yu, an eighteen-year-old high school girl with the same name and surname! Her son is now a seventy-year-old chairman, and she has several handsome great-grandchildren! But each of these great-grandchildren has its own problems. For example, the real Fourth Young Master was mistakenly taken away and raised in the countryside, while the fake Fourth Young Master bullies the family. The youngest Young Master was even led into a casino by the fake Fourth Young Master. And the movie star's grandson, not recognizing his great-grandmother, aided Rong Yu's half-sister, Rong Ruoyao, to deal with Rong Yu. The result? Bloodline, of course! Attention, rebellious grandchildren, your great-grandmother is here!
